questions.q: When does a contract's constructor actually run?
options: Exactly once, at the moment the contract is deployed
Every time any function on the contract is called
Once per day automatically
Only when explicitly called by the contract's owner
questions.explain: A constructor is a special function that executes exactly once, at deployment, and can never be called again afterward.

questions.q: What does the `immutable` keyword actually guarantee?
options: The variable can be set once in the constructor, then never modified again
The variable can be changed at any time by anyone
The variable is always equal to zero
The variable is only visible outside the contract
questions.explain: An immutable variable's value is locked in during the constructor and cannot be changed by any function afterward.

questions.q: Why did Remix refuse to deploy the Immutable contract without extra input from the instructor?
options: The constructor took a real uint256 parameter, which must be supplied before deployment
The contract had a syntax error
Remix requires payment before any deployment
immutable variables can never be set via a constructor
questions.explain: Because the constructor's signature required a uint256 input (_myUint), Remix required a real value be entered before deployment could proceed.

questions.q: In the live demo, what real value did MY_ADDRESS end up holding after deployment?
options: The address of whichever account actually deployed the contract, via msg.sender
A hardcoded address written directly in the source code
The address of the Ethereum Foundation
It stayed unset (the zero address)
questions.explain: The constructor set MY_ADDRESS to msg.sender, which at deployment time is the address of whoever is deploying the contract — confirmed live in the demo.

questions.q: What real value did MY_UINT hold after the instructor deployed with an input of 123?
options: 123 — exactly the value passed to the constructor
0, since immutable variables always default to zero
A random number generated by the EVM
The gas cost of deployment
questions.explain: The constructor assigned MY_UINT the exact input value supplied at deployment — in this case, 123.
